description_en: Retrieves the laboratories in a specified scene
description_zh: 获取某个场景下的实验室列表
kebab_example: aliyun pairecservice list-laboratories --environment Daily --scene-id 3 --status Offline --instance-id pairec-test1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListLaboratories

parameters.description_en:

- `Daily`: the daily environment

- `Pre`: the pre-production environment

- `Prod`: the production environment
